# origincloud_iam_role_bindings (Data Source)

Lists an organization's role bindings, oldest first, optionally only a member's or a project's. Needs `iam.member.list` on the organization. With the parent `organizations/-` it lists the caller's own bindings in every organization and needs no permission; `member` must be empty there.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) The organization whose role bindings to list.

### Read-Only

- `role_bindings` (Attributes List) The role bindings listed, from every page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--role_bindings))

<a id="nestedatt--role_bindings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `role_bindings`

Read-Only:

- `create_time` (String) When the binding was created. An RFC 3339 timestamp, such as `2026-11-01T12:00:00Z`.
- `creator` (String) Who created the binding, written as a member is, or `platform` for a binding the platform made itself. Always `userId:{user}` for a user in a list of the caller's own bindings (`organizations/-`).
- `member` (String) Who holds the role: `user:{email}` or `serviceAccount:{service_account}`. A user is shown with their account's current verified address, as `userId:{user}` when it has none, or as `deleted:user:{user}` once the account is gone.
- `name` (String) The binding's resource name.
- `project` (String) The project the binding is limited to, `projects/{project}`, one of the organization's. Empty for a binding on the whole organization, which covers every project in it.
- `role` (String) The role granted, `roles/{role}`.
- `urn` (String) The binding's URN, the identifier access policies and the audit log use.
